_about: Tidebreak's rules (RingRules, RingMode, RingMenu; the plan's sport_rules; the owner, 2026-10-04: the sport is Tidebreak, 1v1 first, the team lists kept for 3v3). Every number here, tunable by eye. Zones are counted from the centre: 1 nearest it, 3 at the open end. A competitor is 'confined' to the zone a knock carried him into (only deeper within a round); his forward line is then a soft wall. The round ends at once on a ring-out; at the time-out the side holding more ground takes it, then the higher health, else a draw.

spectate._about: RingSpectate (team formats, after your last life): the camera back_m behind the watched fighter from his own end, up_m up, looking ahead_m past him down the deck, eased at ease per second.

coach._about: The team formats' coach (RingMode._coach; the owner, 2026-10-10: 2v2 and 4v4): each bot handed the nearest opponent still in play, spread_m farther for each of its side already on him; looked at again every every_s, switching only for one better by keep_m.

_rule_set: Round 3 (smash_r3 spec §14.1-14.2): "stock" (the default) is the % layer: lives, the launch, the stage overlay (ring.json modes.stock); "classic" is today's zones, kept one round behind the Esc menu's Rules row ("Lives" / "Zones") and pinned by a test. RingRules.stock_on() is true only while a ring with rule_set "stock" is installed: THE GATE every round-3 rule checks. The user arg rules=classic|stock (or RingRules.rule_set_override) picks it for a run.

stock._about: The % layer (smash_r3 spec v2 §2, §3, §7, §8; PERCENT's). Every hit adds d % to the struck competitor (never his health); the higher his %, the faster the next launch: v = W (base + growth R A p/100 (0.5 + d/20)). Out only in the water (or across the tank's curtain at any height). 3 lives, the % back to 0 after each fall, an 8:00 clock, sudden death at 300% when the lives are level at the bell.
stock._pct_scale: Current match pace: 0.95, inherited from the R5 balance work. The round-4 BOTS2 record used 0.86 (previously 1.0) after its spectator bot gained RingMoves. October 2026 candidate C preserves this scale and all launch classes; see docs/tidebreak/astra_balance_verification.md for the fixed samples.
stock._curve: Untagged damage (form_spikes, GustLift, a hit with no tag) converts to d = curve_k (1 - e^(-dmg / curve_s)): 7 -> 2.4, 20 -> 5.6, 55 -> 10.2, 110 -> 12.4. An untagged knock launches at untagged.base_k of its own speed plus untagged.growth.
stock._air_growth: a launch class released airborne grows x air_growth (the Slam and returns exempt: air_exempt, and every tag of a class marked slam)
stock._gravity: the ring's one gravity for every launch (BendKnock.gravity_override while the stock ring stands; MOVE's movement.json has the bodies' own)
stock._di: steering (spec §3.3): read once di_read_s after the hit (MOVE calls BendKnock.apply_di with the held keys); the part across the flight turns the carry's yaw by up to di_deg, never the pitch; held against the flight adds di_against_decel m/s^2 to the carry's decay for di_against_s
stock._tech: breaking the fall (spec §3.4): an E press within tech_s before the deck or a wall breaks it, unless one came tech_s..tech_spoil_s before (spoiled); earlier presses count for nothing. Stand: intangible tech_intangible_s; a roll tech_roll_m (MOVE moves it). Missed on the deck: a bounce when falling faster than bounce_mps (vy x -bounce_k), then lying at least lie_s (intangible lie_intangible_s), up by itself at lie_auto_s. A missed wall: bounced off at wall_miss_k of the flat speed
stock._land_keep: a tumbling body that comes down on the deck (its fall not broken) keeps land_keep of its carry: it skids, it does not glide on. lead_model.py counts a launch that comes down on the deck as one that stayed on it; without this a body landing near the lip slid off it and the in-engine KO % ran under the table's
stock._guards: spec v2 §2.5: in the stock ring every guard stops every attack; AIR's BendZone decides perfect or late (RingRules.guard_outcome: perfect within guard_perfect_s of standing, Lightning perfect only for fire; earth's full catch of a stone within guard_catch_s) and sends it in the hit's info (guard "perfect": 0%, no launch; slide_only or guard "late": late_mult of the % and of the launch, a slide on the feet)
stock._weights: W = 2 / (1 + weight) on the whole launch: earth 1.0, water 1.0256, fire 0.9524, air 1.0526 with the current raw weights below. Earth's Rooted (standing still) multiplies the base only by rooted_base; the attacker's Carried wind (BendZone.carry_wind) multiplies the whole launch by carried_mult.

classes._about: Every move's class (spec v2 §2.3, lead_table.py v2), keyed by the hit info's tag ("id/mode", "id/mode.grown" for a grown move): d the % it adds (after staling), base and growth (m/s) of the launch v = W (base + growth R A p/100 (0.5 + d/20)), angle (degrees over the flat; negative: down), set: a set knock (always its base, never KOs), set_stun: its set hitstun (s; else clamp(hitstun_k v)), volley_n: the projectiles of one volley (each adds d / n; only the first knocks), dir: how its flat way is found (travel: the hit's own travel; up: the travel, raised to its angle; to_caster: toward the caster), launcher: an up-launcher (never a KO class), no_flinch: % only (no knock, no stun), slam: the Slam (its bounce on a body on the deck, exempt from the air factor).
classes._air_close: The air-only close hit per element (the owner's answer 4: AIR casts it on LMB in the air, mode air_hit of the element's jab, its clips own-bend-air-hit-<element>), keyed by the tag AIR sends: a short set knock for strings (moves.json air_hit.class_hint's numbers), never a KO. The Axe Kick's floor wave as it runs on from its Slam (fire_kick/slam_wave): a small set push.

_element_factor: each knock in the ring scaled by knock_scale times the KNOCKER's element's factor (air knocks hardest by design, so it is held back most; R1-BALANCE 2026-10-05: air 0.65 to 0.6, water 1.25 to 1.5, water landing many light knocks and few that carried). KITS round 2 retuned them for the new kits by its soak: knock_scale 0.7 to 1.1 (more rounds into the water than out of time), air 0.6 to 1.5 (its tornado and its socket lifts are gone), earth 1.1 to 0.85, water 1.5 to 0.7, fire 0.9 to 1.35
_max_push_m: one hit moves a body at most this far (m): the flat part of a knock is capped so its slide (v^2 / 2 BendKnock.GROUND_DECEL), and its flight first when it launches (AIR_DECEL over the airtime), stay within it
_max_rounds: drawn rounds score for no one; after this many rounds the match goes to the higher score (a drawn match when level)
_winded_back_m: a winded competitor is set this far behind the line of the zone he is pushed into (m)
_soft_wall: a confined competitor walking forward past his line is pushed back at soft_wall_mps, plus soft_wall_k m/s per m past it; past it by soft_wall_hard_m he is held at that depth (no penalty, play flows)
_edge_guard_m: walking (not knocked) never takes a competitor off his own open end: he is eased back inside this margin (m); a knock carries him over
_knock_credit_s: a zone crossed or a ring-out within this long (s) of a knock is that knock's (BendKnock.last_knocker)
_recover: air and fire recovery (a hover, a glide, a jump) back onto the deck is allowed while the body is not below deck_y - ring.json out_drop_m
_winded_in_last_zone: winded while confined to the last zone is a ring-out, credited to whoever winded him
_side_fall: a fall off a long side (launched over the ropes) is a ring-out like the open end's, credited to the last knocker
_max_walls: the walls one competitor may have standing at once (FormRaised.count_wall): raising one more crumbles his oldest (the owner, 2026-10-05: walls are spammable, cap them as data). 0: no cap. Round 2 (skills spec 2.7): only the WALL key's pieces count (wall_moves: the earth wall, the ice wall; Column and Lift's pillar sink 1.5 s after they rise and never count); the fire wall and the wind wall stand one at a time a caster (one_at_a_time: a second takes the first's place) and short (5 s, 4 s), so the cap of 2 holds earth's and water's walls

stings._about: The round's moments, the ring's own sounds (BendSounds ids, audio/sfx/bend: synthesized, none borrowed; an Sfx id also plays): [id, gain dB, pitch]. The countdown's tick, the gong at the go, the bell at a round's end (a ring-out or the time), the match's gong.
